Date: 2025-03-31 Application Serial No. 18/712,161
Page 6 of 6 Amendment after Allowance Dated: March 31, 2025 REMARKSIn response to the Notice of Allowance dated March 18, 2025, Applicant amends claims 2-6, 8 and 10-13. After entry of this Amendment, claims 1-8 and 10-13 remain in the Application. Applicant respectfully requests entry of this Amendment in the application.Amendments to the Claims Applicant amends claims 2-6, 8 and 10-12 to correct antecedent errors in the preamble.Claim 13 is amended to replace "prevent" with "prohibit" as recited in claim 1.Conclusion It is submitted that this Amendment has antecedent basis in the application as originally filed, including the specification, claims and drawings, and that this Amendment does not add any new subject matter to the application. Applicant submits that this Amendment does not affect the allowability of any claim or of the Application as a whole. It is submitted that this Amendment is suitable for entry under the provisions of 37 CFR 1.312.The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the telephone number listed below if the Examiner has any questions regarding this paper.Respectfully submitted, YOUNG BASILEHANLON & MACFARLANE, P.C./Francine Nesti/ Francine Nesti Registration No. 53376 T: (248) 649-3333 F: (248) 649-3338 3001 West Big Beaver Road, Ste. 624 Troy, Michigan 48084-3107
